lines.lyric_hangul: 안개 속 흐릿하지만 그 속에 누군가 있어
lines.lyric_translation: It’s unclear in the fog / But there’s someone inside

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 느끼듯 익숙하지만 달라 달라 달라
lines.lyric_translation: It’s familiar as if they feel me but / It’s different, different, different

lines.lyric_hangul: 오란 건지 가란 건지 흔드는 손은
lines.lyric_translation: Your waving hand / Not sure if you want me to come or go

lines.lyric: Museun tteushilkka tell me about it
lines.lyric_hangul: 무슨 뜻일까? Tell me about it
lines.lyric_translation: What does it mean, tell me about it

lines.lyric_hangul: 두 개의 지구가 있다면 또 다른 나일 수도 있어
lines.lyric_translation: If there’s two earths / It could be a different me too

lines.lyric_hangul: 한걸음 가까이 가면 꽃길에 가시가 피어
lines.lyric_translation: When I take one step closer / The flower path grows thorns

lines.lyric_hangul: 그때 넌 날 구하려 손 내밀어
lines.lyric_translation: Then you reach out to save me / Hey

parts.lyric: Geuttae neon nal guharyeo son naemireo

lines.lyric: Shigan jinaseo neoreul mannamyeon
lines.lyric_translation: When I meet you after time passes
I’ll know uh (you were my future)
I’ll know uh (I was your yesterday)

lines.lyric: Nae nalgaeppyeoye jageun nalgaeneun dodaeche
lines.lyric_translation: The small wing on my wingbone

lines.lyric: Eonjejjeume keojilkka
lines.lyric_translation: When will it grow bigger

lines.lyric: Namane barami bul ttaena
lines.lyric_translation: When my own wind blows

lines.lyric: I nalgaereul pyeol suna isseulkka
lines.lyric_translation: Is that when I’ll be able to extend these wings

lines.lyric: Nuneul gamabol ttae sumeul swieo bol ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 눈을 감아볼 때, 숨을 쉬어 볼 때
lines.lyric_translation: When I close my eyes, when I breathe

lines.lyric: Naega nareul sogiji aneumyeon
lines.lyric_translation: If I don’t deceive myself

lines.lyric: Banghwanghageona seulpeohaji ana
lines.lyric_translation: I won’t be lost or sad
